border-border/60 bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60 hover:border-border hover:shadow-md"><span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center transition-transform duration-200 group-hover/copy:scale-105"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-clipboard-copy size-4" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="8" height="4" x="8" y="2" rx="1" ry="1"></rect><path d="M8 4H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="workflow">动态工作流<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">动态工作流让 ZCode Agent 先写一段编排脚本，再按脚本调度多个子智能体并行工作、分阶段汇总，最后把结果交回主对话。它适合规模大、步骤多、需要分工协作的任务，例如：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">批量处理</strong>：按统一规则处理大量文件、文档或数据。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">深度调研</strong>：从多个来源并行收集资料，分类整理后形成报告。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">大型代码库任务</strong>：全库审计、代码理解、批量迁移、批量测试与修复。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">交叉核验</strong>：多个子智能体分别产出，再由另一组子智能体审核、返工。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">与 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/subagents">子智能体</a> 相比，动态工作流适合需要固定流程、大量并发和分阶段汇总的任务；简单的一两项分工交给子智能体即可。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/running-cn.webp" alt="对话中的工作流：ZCode Agent 说明五个阶段的编排方案，下方时间线卡片显示六名研究员子智能体正在并行调研" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="enable">开启动态工作流<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">打开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 行为与工具 → 动态工作流</strong>，选择运行方式：</p>
<div class="docs-table mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">选项</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">关闭</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">不能创建新的工作流，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动化</strong> 页也不再显示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作流</strong>；对话中已有的工作流仍可查看</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">通过命令启用</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">只有输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/workflow</code> 命令才会运行新的工作流</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">始终开启</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">除了 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/workflow</code> 命令，ZCode Agent 也会根据你的意图主动运行工作流</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">标有 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">默认</strong> 的选项为当前账号的默认值。修改后对新建或恢复的会话生效。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/setting-cn.webp" alt="设置 → 行为与工具 → 动态工作流下拉菜单：关闭、通过命令启用、始终开启（默认）" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="start">发起工作流<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在输入框中输入 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">/workflow</code>，后面写清楚要完成的任务，例如：</p>
<div class="docs-wrap-code"><pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">/workflow 帮我深度调研一下全球固态电池的产业化进展：主要技术路线、头部企业和量产时间表、成本与瓶颈。最后在 reports/ 下生成一份 HTML 研究报告，麦肯锡研报风格，信息密度高。
</code></pre></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">也可以点击输入框左下角的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">+</strong>，选择 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作流</strong> 插入命令。设置为 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">始终开启</strong> 时，在需求中写明“使用工作流完成以下任务”同样可以发起，ZCode Agent 也可能在判断任务适合时主动发起。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain" style="--figure-max:min(640px, 100%)"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/plus-menu-cn.webp" alt="输入框的 + 菜单：添加分组中有附件、目标与工作流，下方为插件" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">需求描述越具体，编排越准确。可以在需求里直接说明：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">最大并发数</strong>：例如“这个工作流最大并发设为 8”。默认值根据本机 CPU 核数在 4 到 16 之间自动确定。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">子智能体模型</strong>：例如“工作流子智能体使用 GLM-5.3-Flash”，即可由主对话模型规划、Flash 模型执行，兼顾效果与成本。</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="confirm">确认运行<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode Agent 写好编排脚本后，对话中会出现工作流确认卡片，展示工作流名称、阶段、每个阶段的子智能体角色，以及子智能体模型和最大并发数。点开 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">显示完整脚本</strong> 可以查看脚本内容。你可以：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">允许</strong>：仅运行这一次。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">本会话内始终允许</strong>：本会话中再运行工作流时不再询问。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">拒绝</strong>：不运行。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">描述这个工作流应该怎么改</strong>：写下修改意见，ZCode Agent 会据此调整工作流后再请你确认。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">确认前也可以直接调整子智能体模型和最大并发数。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain" style="--figure-max:min(680px, 100%)"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/confirm-cn.webp" alt="运行此工作流？确认卡片：固态电池产业化深度调研，5 个阶段，子智能体运行在 GLM-5.4，最多 16 个子智能体同时运行，第一阶段六名研究员，下方为允许、本会话内始终允许、拒绝和修改意见输入" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="monitor">查看运行进度<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">工作流运行时，对话中会出现一张时间线卡片（见本页开头的图）：每个阶段是一个站点，子智能体以小标签展示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">待开始 / 运行中 / 已完成 / 已失败</strong> 状态，点击标签可查看该子智能体的会话记录。卡片右上角依次是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">配置工作流</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停止运行</strong> 和 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">查看实例详情</strong>；查看实例详情会在右侧面板展示每个阶段、每个子智能体的任务进度、步数与 Token 用量。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain" style="--figure-max:min(560px, 100%)"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261122-workflow/run-details-cn.webp" alt="右侧实例详情面板：全球固态电池产业化研究运行中，视觉规范、调研核实、汇总蓝图和评审四个阶段已完成，主编正在按评审意见修订蓝图与文稿，后续绘图、搭建页面、审稿等阶段待开始；右上角是配置和停止运行" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">运行中可以：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停止运行</strong>：停止后可随时 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">恢复运行</strong>，已完成的步骤会保留。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">配置</strong>：调整子智能体模型或最大并发数。只修改并发数时立即作用于当前运行；修改模型会停止当前运行并以新设置重新开始，已完成的步骤会保留。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">会话列表中，正在运行工作流的会话下方会显示当前进度，方便同时跟进多个任务。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="result">查看结果与保存<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">工作流完成后，ZCode Agent 会在主对话中汇总结果；完成卡片会显示用时、Token、子智能体数和阶段数。工作流发布的报告、表格等产物会以卡片形式出现，点击即可打开。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/done-cn.webp" alt="工作流已完成：主对话给出质量把关与未覆盖范围，完成卡片附带 HTML 研究报告，显示用时 1 时 6 分、24.96M tokens、14 个子智能体、5 个阶段" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点开卡片里的报告即可在 ZCode 中预览，文件同时保存在项目目录中：</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261122-workflow/report-cn.webp" alt="在 ZCode 内置浏览器中预览生成的《全球固态电池产业化研究报告》：深海军蓝封面，下方是规模、时间、成本、技术四张关键指标卡，再往下是图 1 技术路线对比" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果这个流程以后还会用到，点击完成卡片上的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">保存</strong>：</p>
<div class="docs-aside-wrap"><div class="docs-figure docs-aside" style="--aside-width:330px"><div class="docs-aside-media"><span class="relative block flex-1 min-w-0 max-w-full mb-4 rounded-lg transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/save-cn.webp" alt="保存工作流面板：让 ZCode 帮我提炼保存，或按原样直接保存，名称 battery-research、作用域项目，将写入 .zcode/workflows/battery-research.dwf.ts" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in"/></span></div><div class="docs-aside-body"><ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">让 ZCode 帮我提炼保存</strong>：ZCode Agent 会把本次运行提炼成可复用、可传参的工作流，再请你确认。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">或按原样直接保存</strong>：填写名称（字母、数字、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">-</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">_</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.</code>，最多 64 个字符）、选择作用域（<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">项目</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全局</strong>）和说明，点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">直接保存</strong>。</li>
</ul></div></div></div>
<h3 class="group min-w-0 text-2xl font-medium mt-8 mb-3 text-foreground" id="saved">管理已保存的工作流<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h3>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">已保存的工作流显示在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">自动化 → 工作流</strong> 中，按 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">全局</strong> 和各项目分组。点击卡片上的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">运行</strong>，填好参数即可再跑一次；<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">…</strong> 菜单中可以 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">查看详情</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">在对话里修订</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">复制路径</strong>、<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">提升为全局</strong> 或 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">移到项目…</strong>，以及 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">删除工作流</strong>（已有的运行记录会保留）。点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">通过对话创建</strong> 可以从对话开始编写新的工作流，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">工作流设置</strong> 则跳转到上文的开关。工作流以 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.dwf.ts</code> 文件保存：</p>
<div class="docs-table mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">范围</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">位置</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">项目</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">&lt;项目目录&gt;/.zcode/workflows/</code></td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">全局</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">~/.zcode/workflows/</code></td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">项目中与全局同名的工作流优先使用项目版本。</p>
<span class="docs-figure" data-docs-figure="plain"><span class="docs-figure-body"><span class="docs-figure-frame" data-shape="panel"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20261020-workflow/hub-cn.webp" alt="自动化 → 工作流页：全局暂无工作流，industry-research 项目下有刚保存的 battery-research，可点击运行" class="docs-figure-image"/></span></span></span>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="notes">使用说明<span class="relative inline-block w-0 align-middle"><button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></span></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">工作流中的每个子智能体都会独立调用模型，Token 消耗与子智能体数量、任务规模成正比。大规模任务建议为子智能体选择 Flash 等更经济的模型。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">工作流子智能体不能再发起新的工作流；<a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/idle-time-tasks">闲时任务</a> 中不会运行工作流。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">模型侧出现额度、鉴权等错误时，工作流会停止并标记为模型侧错误；网络波动时会自动重试。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
